title: fix(scenarios): credit master-detail inline edit by the master's field groups, not inlineEdit: true
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr

Fixes #37127
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感:只改场景卡评分器;主从子表「在主记录表单内联编辑」这一项,改为只看主对象的字段分组是否放置了子表。
- 为什么做:主从子表的内联由主对象字段分组决定(「一律只看分组」),评分器却仍按已退役的布尔开关给分,按正规方式内联的构建反被判不合格。
- 出错会怎样:只影响场景评测分数,不影响任何运行中的应用;可直接回退本次改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`records-forms.master-detail-inline-edit` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`) credits a master-detail child as edited inline ONLY when a field group of its MASTER (the FK's `reference`) names it in `fieldGroups[].relatedList` (by child object name or `object.field`) and the FK is one a group may place. This is the runtime's own test, with the same two spec predicates: objectui `attachInlineSubforms` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`, lines 773-774) inlines a child only when `isGroupPlaceableRelationship(fk) && fieldGroupsPlaceRelationship(groupsOf(fk.reference), child, fk)` (`packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts`, lines 80 and 110). `inlineEdit` takes no part. The `asserts` sentence and `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` (the tag table) say the same.

## Deviation from the card

The card asks to credit a child also "when `inlineEdit` is `'grid'` / `'form'`". This PR does not. It follows the maintainer's field-group ruling on #35889 (record 7046311205, 「一律只看分组」), which outranks the card's wording: the runtime inlines nothing without a placing field group (MetadataProvider.tsx L773-775; `inlineEdit` only feeds `resolveInlineMode`, the form factor). A scorer that credited it would pass a build that inlines nothing. Decided by the PM (zone a4-A).

## Tests

`packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`:

- The rich fixture inlines the tasks the supported way: a `project` field group naming `task`, no `inlineEdit` on the FK.
- The degradation table pins two failing shapes: no placing group, and a lone retired `inlineEdit: true`.
- A `describe` pins: field-group placement credits, by child name and by `object.field`; a group on the CHILD, or a group naming an FK with `relatedList: true`, does not credit; `inlineEdit: true` alone does not credit; `'grid'` and `'form'` with no placing group do not credit; a placed child credits under either form factor.

## Acceptance notes

- **Serial: lands after #36802** (merged at 22:27Z; `main` merged into this branch since). Its `corpus.ts` places the golden corpus control cards' children (`invoice_with_line_items`, `project_with_tasks`) with field groups; before it, those two `scenario-cards.test.ts` pins read red under the corrected tag. Measured green with #36802's `corpus.ts` in place at head `2c1f1e68fa`: 137/137 across `scenario-cards.test.ts` and `scenario-tags.test.ts`. The CI run on the merged head is the verdict.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/score/` should pass, including the `master-detail inline edit` describe and both control cards.

Files to read first:

1. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`, the tag's `run`. The risk is the master lookup: `rawObject(f, field.reference)` is matched by normalised name.
2. `packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`, the rich fixture edit in `richArtifact`. Every other tag scores this fixture.

Readings: the dev reports on #37127 (round 1 and fix round 7146536492).
